title: Ombudsman, NSW
summary: This page provides information about the NSW Ombudsman, who investigates complaints about NSW government services.
who_can_apply: You must have a complaint about how NSW government services are delivered.
what_you_need: Details of the complaint you wish to make.

faqs.q: What does the NSW Ombudsman do?
faqs.a: The Ombudsman investigates complaints about how NSW government services are delivered.

faqs.q: How can I make a complaint?
faqs.a: You can make a complaint online through the NSW Ombudsman website.

faqs.q: What types of complaints can the Ombudsman help with?
faqs.a: The Ombudsman provides information on complaints they can help with, including details on how to make a complaint.
